subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: What live Slack evidence is sufficient to choose the first failing boundary for this reaction-only Socket Mode delivery report?
rationale: Current source and tests prove handler-level support, but they do not identify whether the missing live event is lost before Bolt, at OpenClaw account filtering, or during later authorization/routing.

options.title: Request current-main live diagnostics
options.body: Ask for redacted Socket Mode raw envelope/status/trace evidence before queueing code changes.

options.title: Fold into broader Socket Mode tracking
options.body: Close or reclassify this only if maintainers decide the remaining problem is the broader Slack Socket Mode liveness issue rather than reaction-specific delivery.

options.title: Attempt a source-only fix
options.body: Patch the suspected filter or handler path without live evidence, accepting a higher chance of changing the wrong boundary.

recommendation.title: Request current-main live diagnostics
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Socket Mode raw envelope/status/trace evidence before queueing code changes.
